description: Turns an address or UK postcode into latitude and longitude, with the matched address and the source (US Census Geocoder, postcodes.io or Nominatim). Use it to check the pin before the other tools.

address.description: Street address with town and ZIP or postcode, e.g. "7090 State Highway 80, Cooperstown, NY 13326" or "Ambleside LA22 9BB". Not needed when lat and lon are given.

country.description: Optional hint for the address lookup.

name: locate_address
title: Find an address
